title: Coordinating HDB's Repairs and Redecoration Works with Town Councils' Works
what_it_is: Coordinating HDB's Repairs and Redecoration Works with Town Councils' Works

sections.label: HDB MSCP repair and redecoration
sections.summary: HDB uses a seven-year R&R cycle for MSCPs, and TCs may carry out MSCP R&R works with full reimbursement plus a 5% agency fee.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB generally adopts a seven-year cycle for R&R works for HDB MSCPs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The R&R cycles of HDB MSCPs and residential blocks may not fully align, as there could be instances where R&R works are expedited, such as in response to public feedback on estate maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Where there are synergies from carrying out R&R works for MSCPs together with the residential blocks, HDB encourages TCs to undertake the R&R works for the MSCPs on HDB's behalf.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under the maintenance agreement between HDB and TCs, for HDB car parks, TCs can opt to carry out the R&R works for MSCPs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: TCs that opt to do so will receive full reimbursement from HDB for the cost of the R&R works for the MSCPs, in addition to a 5% agency fee.

sections.label: TCs choosing MSCP R&R works
sections.summary: Some TCs choose to undertake MSCP R&R works and some do not, while TCs largely manage the R&R cycle for their own residential blocks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Some TCs choose to take it up, some TCs choose not to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: But if they want to undertake the MSCP R&R works, they can and I have also explained the way in which HDB will reimburse the TCs for doing so.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: By and large, we leave it to the TCs to manage the R&R cycle for their own residential blocks.
